rule.name: ReplacingCollectionMerge
rule.message: This merges maps whose values are collections into one target from more than one source by replacing the whole collection of a key that an earlier source may already have filled, so the values of a key seen twice are lost and the result depends on the order of the sources. Merge the values instead: target.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new HashSet()).addAll(values), or target.merge(key, values, combine).
